keyEvents.text: Goal! York City 1, Northampton Town 0. Ollie Pearce (York City) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! York City 2, Northampton Town 0. Ollie Pearce (York City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! York City 3, Northampton Town 0. Alex Hunt (York City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Harry Boyes.
Joe Wormleighton (Northampton Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
